summary.pack_description:
He shoots, he scores! From one-timers to backhanders, shorties to penalty shots – our Light the Lamp collection of players finding the back of the net is sure to bring you out of your seat. 

Featuring last-second OT winners, top cheese snipes, and franchise record-breakers, from Sam Reinhart, Brad Marchand, Cale Makar, Elias Pettersson, Leon Draisaitl, Mathew Barzal and more!

Each pack contains 1 Light the Lamp highlight, 2 Stadiums & Skylines highlights, 1 Base 2023-24 highlight, plus 1 mystery highlight that could be from Light the Lamp (75%), Next-Gen Class (12.9%), Opening Ice 2023-24 (10%), Cause for a Celly: ‘90s (2%), or The Greatest Achievements sets (<1%).

release.name: Light the Lamp Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Friday March 29, 2024 at 1PM ET / 10AM PT

 

Price: $29 USD

# Packs Available: 3,000. Edition numbers are distributed randomly upon purchase.

 

Purchase Limit: Ten (10) pack limit per person for the first 24 hours; limit increased to fifty (50) pack limit per person afterwards. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 5

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • One (1) highlight from Light the Lamp (Limited #/500)
  • Two (2) highlights from Stadiums & Skylines (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight from Base 2023-24 (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 75% Light the Lamp (Limited #/500)
    • 12.9% Next-Gen Class (Limited #/500)  — one of the first chances to pull Quinton Byfield!
    • 10% Opening Ice 2023-24 (Rare #/250)
    • 2% Cause for a Celly: ‘90s (Epic #/100)
    • 0.1% The Greatest Achievements (Legendary #/10)

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Full Highlights List
  • Light the Lamp, Series 1 - Preview
  • Stadiums & Skylines, Series 1 - Preview
  • Base 2023-24, Series 1 - Preview
  • Next-Gen Class, Series 1 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: 2023-24, Series 1 - Preview
  • Cause for a Celly: ‘90s, Series 1 - Preview
  • The Greatest Achievements, Series 1 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 1 highlights will only be distributed during Series 1, which ends ~September 2024. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Light the Lamp
summary.description: Dive into the heart-pounding moment the puck crosses the goal line with our exclusive collectible set, 'Light the Lamp.' This collection features players scoring thrilling goals, capturing the very essence of why they are cherished as impactful contributors. Each highlight in 'Light the Lamp' serves as a snapshot of electrifying plays showcasing the player's skill and finesse as they find the back of the net. From jaw-dropping breakaways to top corner snipes, these extraordinary highlights remind us why these players are known for their game-changing prowess.

summary.name: Stadiums & Skylines
summary.description: Introducing "Stadiums & Skylines," a set that celebrates the thrilling past and present moments from a diverse array of NHL outdoor games. This unique collection showcases iconic stadiums and breathtaking skylines as the backdrop to unforgettable hockey events. Immerse yourself in the excitement of these outdoor spectacles with "Stadiums & Skylines," where the magic of hockey meets the awe-inspiring settings that make these games truly extraordinary.

summary.name: Cause for a Celly: '90s
summary.description:
The Cause For A Celly: '90s collection immortalizes unforgettable NHL playoff highlights from the '90s that helped define the sport, featuring many of the game's greatest players and iconic moments that have left an indelible mark on hockey history.

Relive the exhilarating moments, featuring both legendary players and game or series-changing plays. From stunning overtime goals to game-saving glove saves, Cause For A Celly: '90s captures the drama, passion, and intensity of the playoffs like never before.

This exclusive set delves into the annals of NHL history, bringing to life the brilliance of great players and the unforgettable moments that have shaped the postseason.

summary.name: Ray Bourque
summary.description:
After an illustrious career spanning 22 seasons, Ray Bourque finally achieved the ultimate triumph of hoisting the Stanley Cup. At the age of 40, in what would be his final year in professional hockey, Bourque fulfilled his long-standing dream of winning this highly coveted trophy. This remarkable achievement added to the numerous accolades he had already earned, including holding the record for the most goals, assists and points in NHL history by a defenseman, along with five Norris Trophy awards. Leading up to this historic victory, Bourque showcased his invaluable contributions by scoring the game-winning goal during Game 3 of the Stanley Cup Final. With the game tied and a power play in progress, a crucial faceoff ensued in the early moments of the third period. Bourque skillfully seized control of the puck after it was won back to him, swiftly gliding towards the center of the ice before unleashing a powerful slapshot that flew past the formidable Martin Brodeur. Then, on June 9, 2001, following a resounding 3-1 victory by the Colorado Avalanche in Game 7, team captain Joe Sakic received the coveted Stanley Cup from Commissioner Gary Bettman. In a deeply significant gesture, Sakic promptly skated over to Bourque, personally handing off the cherished trophy to the deserving veteran. This poignant moment served as the culmination of Bourque's extraordinary career, marking the pinnacle of his accomplishments and forever etching his name into hockey lore.

summary.name: Teemu Selanne
summary.description:
Teemu Selanne scored his third goal of the game during the third period, securing his record-setting 54th goal of the 1992-93 season. This impressive feat surpassed Mike Bossy's rookie record of 53 goals, which had been set fifteen seasons earlier. The play unfolded when Selanne's teammate, Tie Domi, launched the puck high into the air, landing near center ice. In a display of speed and skill, Selanne outpaced the defenseman, swatting a backhander past the sliding goalie to secure the record-breaking goal. The ice quickly filled with Selanne's jubilant teammates, celebrating his accomplishment. To commemorate the occasion, the team awarded Selanne a stick, which he raised towards the crowd at center ice in a gesture of gratitude. The rookie season for "The Finnish Flash" saw him tally an astounding 76 goals, obliterating the previous record and earning him the prestigious Calder Trophy.

summary.name: Wayne Gretzky
summary.description:
During the 1993-94 season, Wayne Gretzky achieved a historic milestone by surpassing his childhood idol, Gordie Howe, to become the NHL's all-time leading goal scorer. The remarkable play unfolded with Luc Robitaille spearheading the attack, entering the opposing zone and executing a drop pass back to Gretzky. Displaying his exceptional playmaking abilities, Gretzky swiftly delivered a pass to Jari Kurri, who in turn sent the puck over to Marty McSorley. Positioned unmarked on the left side, Gretzky received a pass from McSorley, allowing him to effortlessly tap the puck into the net for the goal. The electrified crowd erupted in cheers as the Kings' bench swiftly flooded the ice, celebrating this incredible accomplishment. The memorable moment came in Gretzky’s 15th NHL season, one in which “The Great One” led the League in both assists and points.
